# Kmphitech - Review

Independent first-hand review of one software development project with Kmphitech LLP.

## Site navigation

- Home / site index: https://123thundercousins-a11y.github.io/Kmphitech-REVIEW/
- Full project review: https://123thundercousins-a11y.github.io/Kmphitech-REVIEW/kmphitech-review.html
- Review requests and order completion: https://123thundercousins-a11y.github.io/Kmphitech-REVIEW/review-pressure.html

## Core facts

- Developer: Kmphitech LLP
- Project: software mobile application and web panel
- Original proposal date: 2 June 2025
- Original stated timeline: 56 business days
- Recorded Fiverr payments: ₹6,39,547.87
- Project activity continued into September 2026
- Platforms: Android, iOS and web

## Main topics documented

- Original written scope and milestone structure
- Repeated deadline and milestone changes
- Customer-reported communication gaps and repeated follow-ups
- KPI / biomass / ADG / FCR calculation discussions
- Deployment and store-review history
- Post-deployment production issues and fixes
- Customer-reported review requests while work remained outstanding
- Customer-reported assurances that remaining work would be taken care of
- The practical effect of order completion and the normal cancellation window

## Balance and qualification

This site documents one customer's first-hand experience. It does not claim that every Kmphitech LLP customer has experienced the same outcome.

Where Kmphitech provided an explanation, that explanation is presented separately in the full project review. The review distinguishes customer statements, company statements and recorded project events.

Last updated: 4 October 2026.
